description: Enhanced coverage for connection string parsing with socket paths, percent-encoded URL components, and malformed numeric fields.

input.connection_string: host=/var/run/postgresql port=6543 user=socket_user password=secret dbname=socketdb sslmode=disable application_name=socketapp search_path=public connect_timeout=12

cases.expected_output:
status=ok
host=/var/run/postgresql
port=6543
database=socketdb
user=socket_user
password=secret
connect_timeout_seconds=12
tls=disabled
runtime_params={"application_name":"socketapp","search_path":"public"}
validate_connect=false
fallback_count=0

status=ok
host=db.example.com
port=15432
database=encoded db
user=user@example
password=p@ss/word
connect_timeout_seconds=0
tls=disabled
runtime_params={"application_name":"my app"}
validate_connect=false
